text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A DM? Someone wants me to make
them a beat
track, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(It's not often, but I do get requests now
and
again to !monad, since it's my side
account for
posting music.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Song composition's an analytical
diversion and a
nice change of pace, but
it's just a way to kill
time. I've got zero
interest in making music for
other
people. I'll just ignore—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Another one? "Could you please
make me a
track? You can have full
artistic freedom over it.
I'd like to lay
some vocals over your sound."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Full artistic freedom? They wouldn't
give me that
if they were looking for a
freebie or cheap labor.
Guess they want
something that says "me," huh?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Geez... there's nothing logical about this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Still, I've never put a piece together knowing it would have rap lyrics over it. I'm not getting any ideas here.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I could just edit some stock music and
call it a
day... or...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Shakur... It's almost time for lights
out, so...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I'll turn them off. Night.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm... Shakur's not going to sleep,
she's been
on her laptop this whole
time... It looks like she's
listening to
music.)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(She did the same thing after her last
race, too.
She looked so troubled then.
Maybe she's got
something on her mind
again.)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's anything I can do to
help...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I get that you wanted to help, but of all people, this is who you went to for advice?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I thought she would be the best choice
since
she's the most knowledgeable
person on music I
know...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The time has come for T.M. Opera
O to take
the stage!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When Doto asked me whether I knew of
any
delightful music that might assuage
your stress, I
knew the answer was right
in front of us!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Shakur, choose! Would you prefer
an
emotional hip-hop enka ballad by
Doto or a
fabulous hip-hop opera by
yours truly?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? The heck is that?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you were partial to hip-hop,
you see,
so Doto and I thought to put on
a show for you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do my best to make the lyrics
rhyme, so go
ahead and choose
whichever of us you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey. You there. You choose.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You've been gawking at us the whole
time,
haven't you? Choose whichever
you like the
sound of. I won't be held
responsible.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Well, I can't say that I'm
surprised!
Excellent choice! Please enjoy
"My Beloved
Rhyme"! Now, da capo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The name is Opera O! You'll not find a
better
Uma than this here Uma!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O, rose-scented Opera O! What a
fragrance I
infuse everywhere! ♪ Now,
my loving audience,
let me see you put
your hands up in the air!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And now, the fall of the curtain upon this hip-hopera shooooow! O sole miiiioooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That was zero percent hip-hop and zero
percent
opera. It was straight up in the
negatives.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The lyrics rhymed, though, yes? Besides, everything I, Opera O, perform constitutes an opera! Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The parameters of that definition are
way too
loose.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But... I guess I get it. If it's something in
my style they
want, anything I make'll fit
the bill, so I'll just do
whatever I feel
like.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, it seems I've managed to bestow
some
wisdom upon Shakur the sage!
Goodness, it must
be criminal how
incredible I am!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Doto, I owe you a lunch. And bring
her with
you. Put some tape over her
mouth first, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh! Thanks, Shakur! ...Wait, tape?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Doto. You'd better watch out.
Don't go
overboard, or you'll land
yourself in a world of
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but I want to do the best I can! Okay,
MC Doto
is, um, in the house!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yo, yooo. ♪ I'm going to hit the redline
with my
rhymes! ♪ Pedal to the metal,
but don't do
crimes! La la la! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... ♪ I-Ice creeeam is delicious...
It'll leave
you... incredulous. ♪
Dum-dee-dee-dummm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm! Wait, that melody just now...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um, sometimes I overhear your
music, so I
looked up one of the songs...
S-sorry for being
nosy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But I thought if I learned about the
things you
like, then we could talk about
them, and it would
help you relax and
improve your mood...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that lousy enka performance not
only got
rid of the tension in my body,
but all my wits—as
well as the artist's
block I was dealing with.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah! Oh, Shakuuur!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, I had no idea you were so
troubled, Shakur!
In that case, let me
imbue you with inspiration
and sing for
you "The Glorious Return of Opera
O"!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Please don't.
